forecast.method: Five models are backtested on each city's monthly rent series (rolling origin, 1-6 months ahead) and scored by WMAPE; the most accurate is used. The population-driven model applies a Metro Vancouver regression of asking-rent growth on BC population growth to each city's BC Stats population estimates and projections. Shaded bands are 80% intervals from backtest errors.
